name: Queen of Wands
meaning_for_today: Today brings confidence, charm, and creative energy. You can attract attention, inspire others, and achieve success through determination and optimism.
card_advice: Believe in your abilities and express yourself openly. Stay warm and confident, but avoid becoming overly demanding or jealous.

upright.short: Confidence, charisma, creativity, independence, passion, optimism.
upright.general: The Queen of Wands symbolizes a strong, attractive, and energetic person who knows how to inspire others. She represents creativity, self-confidence, leadership, and emotional warmth. This card encourages bold self-expression, independence, and trust in personal talents.
upright.in_love: In relationships, the Queen of Wands signifies passion, attraction, loyalty, and emotional openness. It may describe a confident and caring partner who brings warmth and excitement into the relationship.
upright.in_situation: Success comes through charisma, initiative, and creative thinking. The situation favors social activity, leadership, and personal influence.

reversed.short: Jealousy, insecurity, manipulation, arrogance, emotional volatility.
reversed.general: Reversed, the Queen of Wands may indicate low self-esteem hidden behind pride, controlling behavior, selfishness, or emotional instability. Energy may become chaotic or overly dramatic.
reversed.in_love: There may be jealousy, possessiveness, emotional manipulation, or unstable passion within the relationship.
reversed.in_situation: A lack of confidence or misuse of influence creates tension. It is important to regain emotional balance and avoid acting impulsively.
